notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Bare, treeless mountains, often flat-topped, with long horizontal rocky ridgelines; in the southeast they soften into rolling green hills.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Long white plates with blue text; if unblurred, a straw-hat emblem shows on the left.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Yellow outer edge lines and white inner lines; the same scheme is used in four neighbouring southern African countries.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Some roads have a triple centre line: two solid lines with a dashed one between. Found only in this region of southern Africa.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage is Generation 3: the back of a white car with no antenna is usually visible.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Traffic drives on the left, as in the other southern African neighbours.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Traditional round huts with thatched roofs are common in rural areas, more so than in neighbouring countries.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Agave plants are common across the countryside and make a good hint.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Grassland is mostly short grass, which helps tell it apart from the famously tall-grassed Eswatini.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Many people wear traditional dress, especially thick woollen blankets draped over the shoulders.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Free-roaming livestock on the roads is very common: mostly cows, plus horses and donkeys.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is sparse, especially in the southeast where it is mostly yellow-line roads; all urban coverage is in the northwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Two big man-made reservoirs are visible from some mountain roads; the larger one is seen from the A25.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Roadworks on the A5 leave mostly white-painted sticks beside the road as makeshift bollards, on a wide dark-brown dirt road.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The road to the southeastern national park is unpaved with light-brown soil, grassy high terrain and pale exposed rocks.
